observation: The repository used the word dogfood for three different evidence strengths. The installed release-set asset gate proves skills/hooks are projected, while the self-shape runner compiles Recall but explicitly withholds guidance judgement because it never reads system.md. The quick-start built agent-map only after workflow approve even though approve is the point that compiles Recall from map files that already exist. Separately, package-owned Git hooks could be installed but this repository had no tracked .agent-loop/githooks.json, so pre-commit reported no configured checks; GitHub API/connector commits cannot execute local Git hooks in any case. These are capability/ordering boundaries, not model reluctance.

evidence.summary: tools/self-shape-dogfood.php calls RecallOutcomeDraft::withholdInFile with the explicit reason that the harness never reads system.md. The installed release-set CI separately checks projected host files, so compilation/projection were being observed without agent consumption.

WorkflowApproveCommand passes map/search-index paths to Recall only when they already exist, while the previous docs/quick-start.md ordered workflow approve before map build. Building the map afterwards therefore could not influence the already-compiled briefing.

GitHookConfig defaults to an empty check list when .agent-loop/githooks.json is absent and PreCommitRunner exits successfully with 'No pre-commit checks configured.' The repository did not track that config and .gitignore ignored .agent-loop/* by default.

evidence.command: GitHub Actions PR #124 initial candidate runs
evidence.summary: Acceptance-criteria and prompt-primitives candidate dogfoods passed, the governed L2 execution-contract dogfood passed, and installed release-set dogfood passed independently. Their separate green results demonstrate that these gates exercise different capability planes rather than one end-to-end agent-host behavior.

hypothesis: Agent workflow integrations appear unused when installation, deterministic compilation, host consumption, and local Git execution are treated as one implicit bootstrap. A mechanism cannot affect an agent before the host loads it, Recall cannot consume a map built after compilation, and local Git hooks cannot run in a GitHub API write path.
validated_conclusion: Classify dogfood evidence as installer, deterministic lifecycle, or agent-host behavior before making claims. For agent-host runs, project skills before starting the clean session; build map/search evidence before workflow approval; select L2 recipes in the approved Contract and distinguish compilation from actual system.md consumption. Track project hook policy when local hooks are expected, and mark hooks not_exercised when the host writes through an API that bypasses local Git.
